meta.name: financial-reporting-and-close
meta.description: Runs the period-end close and produces reporting — close calendar, reconciliations, accruals, variance analysis, and reporting that gets read. Use this to shorten or stabilize a monthly close, design a close checklist, investigate a variance, structure management reporting, or work out why the numbers keep changing after close.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成月度结账,并输出财务报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每月月底需要手工对账出报表,还常被数字对不上困扰。
copy.tagline_en: Automate your month-end close and produce reliable financial reports.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend late nights on manual reconciliations and the numbers keep shifting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会把期末结账当作关键路径流程来设计：列出任务与依赖、设定硬性截止，推进对账并对应计依据留档；产出写明基线的差异分析，并区分时点与持续运行率因素。
howto.when: 当你想设计或优化月度结账、查某个差异、搞懂为什么结账后数字老变等情况时，会触发。

say.text: 帮我规划下个月结账的关键路径，标出前置任务和负责人。
say.note: Claude会给出结账任务清单与依赖顺序。

say.text: 和预算比，这个月销售费用差了8万，分析下原因。
say.note: 它会给出带基线说明的差异分析。

say.text: 结账后数字又变了，帮我排查哪里出了问题。
say.note: Claude会检查未清对账项和截止纪律。

howto.what_en: Claude plans the close as a critical path, maps tasks and dependencies, sets a hard cutoff, drives reconciliations and documented accruals, and reports variances against a stated baseline (timing vs run-rate).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to design or optimize a monthly close, investigate a variance, or explain why numbers keep changing after close.

say_en.text: Help me plan next month's close as a critical path with owners and dependencies.
say_en.note: Claude returns the close task sequence and order.

say_en.text: Why did sales expense exceed budget by $80K this month?
say_en.note: It creates a baseline-based variance report.

say_en.text: Numbers keep changing after close. Help me find the cause.
say_en.note: Claude checks open reconciliation items and cutoff discipline.
